verdict.rationale: Companies House offers online filing, so publishing operating hours, per-day limits or session timeouts for that flow is a fair question. The pack has no evidence of any such disclosure for the founder-facing online filing flow. The only related item is a developer API 'Rate limiting' guide, which covers a different surface and is not an up-front notice on the filing flow.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
